video_title: Cavs at Knicks | Kenny Atkinson Post Game | 11.25.2026

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the Cavs' fourth-quarter turnover issues
quotes.excerpt: I felt like in the fourth quarter we had a couple live-ball turnovers. That got them going.
quotes.quote: I would say three quarters, really good basketball on both our processes, right? Defensive disposition was right. I felt like in the fourth quarter we had a couple live-ball turnovers. That got them going. Their role players stepped up big time, hit some shots. You got to give them credit. We played three quarters of really good basketball and give them credit. They got us in that fourth quarter.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the Cavs played three quarters of good basketball against the Knicks but live ball turnovers in the fourth quarter ultimately cost them the game

structured.context: Kenny Atkinson discusses the team's performance and turnover issues during the fourth quarter of the loss against the Knicks.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson praises Donovan Mitchell's aggressive play
quotes.excerpt: I loved how Donovan Mitchell played tonight. He was downhill, downhill, paint, paint.
quotes.quote: They mixed it up tonight. They weren't blitzing them all the time. They blitzed sometimes and then sometimes they were in coverage, so they balanced it out. But I loved how Donovan Mitchell played tonight. He was downhill, downhill, paint, paint. And just as a team, I felt like we were very aggressive, making the right plays. Unfortunately, our shot quality was excellent, but the threes didn't go down tonight.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson praised Donovan Mitchell for his aggressive play tonight saying he was downhill and paint focused despite the team struggling to hit threes

structured.context: Kenny Atkinson praises Donovan Mitchell for his aggressive play and ability to attack the paint despite the team's shooting struggles.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson identifies turnovers as the cause of the fourth-quarter collapse
quotes.excerpt: I think the turnovers. I think we had a couple untimely turnovers and some missed shots.
quotes.quote: I think the turnovers. I think we had a couple untimely turnovers and some missed shots that led to leak-out transition. I think they got some easy ones. Alvarado got I think two threes in transition. So, if I was to say correct, we could have been better in transition defense. We do raid and go to the offensive boards hard. I think we had some that bounced long and they got ahead, got some easy baskets that got the momentum going their way. But the live-ball turnovers like on the road, they hurt you. That's how momentum swings, and I think that was part of it.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson points to untimely turnovers and transition defense lapses as the primary reasons for the fourth quarter collapse against the Knicks

structured.context: Kenny Atkinson explains how turnovers and transition defense allowed the opponent to gain momentum in the fourth quarter.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on addressing the team's recurring bad quarters
quotes.excerpt: I wish sometimes it's the first quarter you can figure the lineup or we will look.
quotes.quote: I wish sometimes it's the first quarter you can figure the lineup or we will look at the lineups as always and see, you know, dive deeper into that. But you are right, we got to figure that out. Three quarters, playing three quarters of good basketball isn't enough in this league.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson admits the Cavs need to figure out their recurring issues in specific quarters noting that playing three quarters of good basketball is not enough in this league

structured.context: Kenny Atkinson addresses the need to evaluate team lineups after struggling to maintain consistent performance across all four quarters.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on maintaining team spirit despite recent losses
quotes.excerpt: Spirit is better than ever. I did tell the guys I think sometimes it's hard to see progress.
quotes.quote: Spirit is better than ever. I did tell the guys I think sometimes it's hard to see progress behind a loss or two losses in a row. But listen, progress is not a straight line. It doesn't, it's not how this works. I think we did a lot of good things. I think you have some dips in the win-loss column. You have dips and then you respond and then we will keep building and we will get on a run like we have the past two years. But like I said, I think our process is right in many ways. We just couldn't sustain.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the team spirit is better than ever despite recent losses adding that progress is not a straight line and the team will keep building

structured.context: Kenny Atkinson comments on the team's morale and process following a string of recent losses.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on whether the team's struggles were predictable
quotes.excerpt: I think turnovers hurt you. I'm just kind of repeat that. Missed, I thought we had great looks.
quotes.quote: I think turnovers hurt you. I'm just kind of repeat that. Missed, I thought we had great looks. I didn't feel like we were forcing shots or taking bad shots. We were in the paint. I didn't look at the three-point numbers, I'm sure they were pretty poor. Then they, you know, long rebounds, they get easy, easy ones and that's just avalanches from there.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the Cavs were getting great looks and not forcing shots but poor three point shooting and long rebounds led to an avalanche in the fourth quarter

structured.context: Kenny Atkinson reiterates that turnovers and poor three-point shooting were the primary factors in the team's fourth-quarter collapse.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on defensive progress despite the loss
quotes.excerpt: I thought defensively tonight we made progress. I liked our competitiveness. I liked how physical we were.
quotes.quote: I thought defensively tonight we made progress. I liked our competitiveness. I liked how physical we were. Like I said, fourth quarter was a bad stretch, but we did a lot of good things defensively. Protect the paint, didn't have that many rim attempts. So, like you said, it's four quarters. It's not three's not enough. But as a coach, I try to take away the positives, what we're doing positives. Now we just got to, we got to do it for longer.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says he saw defensive progress from the Cavs tonight despite the loss noting the team was physical and protected the paint well for most of the game

structured.context: Kenny Atkinson reflects on the defensive improvements the team showed despite the overall loss.
